title: Object Storage: outage refund — recorded outcome
content:
For Object Storage outage refund, for an authorization not exceeding available refund, pay the authorized amount, rounded half-up to the tier monetary precision; an amount exceeding available is refused rather than reduced. Amounts below refund minimum remain on account.

## Basis Q&A

What determines outage refund in this situation? For an authorization not exceeding available refund, pay the authorized amount, rounded half-up to the tier monetary precision; an amount exceeding available is refused rather than reduced. Amounts below refund minimum remain on account.

## Hypothetical outage refund amount

Assume hypothetical available cash return of USD 50 and an exact authorization of USD 51. That authorization is refused rather than reduced to USD 50. If the authorization instead equals USD 50 and meets the applicable minimum, USD 50 is paid.
